entities.name: Karel Koželuh
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Karel Koželuh was a Czech tennis, association football, and ice hockey player of the 1920s and 1930s. Koželuh became a European ice hockey champion in 1925 and was one of the top-ranked players on the professional tennis circuit in the 1930s.
